test_is_mlx_available: test if the MLX package is importable in the current environment
build_use_mlx: build a check to verify MLX is opt-in via SGLANG_USE_MX environment variable and available
convert_torch_to_mlx: convert a PyTorch tensor to an MLX array using numpy as intermediate for zero-copy on unified memory
convert_mlx_to_torch: convert an MLX array to a PyTorch tensor with optional MPS device placement and size-limit safety
sync_mlx_operations: synchronize pending MLX operations before converting arrays to ensure all computations complete
